resource.name: Pennsylvania Horticultural Society (PHS): Landscape Programs and McLean Library
resource.description: Philadelphia-based nonprofit connecting landscape and garden practice with public education, community gardens, tree stewardship, vacant-land maintenance and university research partnerships. Its McLean Library provides horticultural references, digitized visual collections and finding aids for organizational records. LandCare documents delivery methods and links to published evaluation studies. A reference for landscape design, environmental learning, institutional archives and long-term neighborhood stewardship.

resource.audit_note: Official homepage, McLean Library, LandCare model and impact pages, June 16, 2026 program expansion, Flower Show program and terms reviewed. Library reading resources are distinct from member borrowing and appointment-based historical collection access. Digital collection and finding-aid links were confirmed on the library page, but their external destinations returned 429 and 403; item browsing and downloads were not tested. New navigation paths were unavailable, while established official pages remained readable. A linked 2018 JAMA Network Open cluster randomized trial was inspected in HTML for design, results and limitations: its self-reported outcomes and Philadelphia setting do not validate every PHS claim or establish effects elsewhere. Overall poor-mental-health reduction was not statistically significant; no unqualified health percentages reproduced. The newer 2025-2026 program-evaluation PDF was linked but not reviewed. PHS reserves website and media rights; collection items and scholarly articles have separate terms, including CC BY for the inspected JAMA paper. No blanket reuse license, data download, registration or independent outcome replication. No standalone articles, library events or supplier listings added.

event.name: PHS Philadelphia Flower Show 2027: ICONIC
event.description: Ticketed horticultural and landscape-design exhibition at the Pennsylvania Convention Center. The 2027 theme, ICONIC, examines gardens' influence across art, design, fashion, food, film and architecture, with a planned Pennsylvania public-gardens showcase. General-public dates are March 13-21; March 12 is a members-only preview, not general admission. Daily hours and ticket categories differ. A public exhibition and fundraiser, not a scholarly conference; no livestream confirmed.
event.source: Official PHS 2027 theme, show overview, FAQ and ticket page reviewed November 11, 2026. https://phsonline.org/the-flower-show/about-the-show/iconic; https://phsonline.org/the-flower-show/plan-your-visit/faq; https://phsonline.org/the-flower-show/buy-tickets/ Older overview includes March 12 in headline dates, but explicitly identifies it as Members' Preview Day; current FAQ and indexed overview confirm March 13-21 public admission. Scheduled program, not confirmation of occurrence. Ticket checkout, live inventory and final exhibitor roster not tested. Original summary and links only; no media reproduced.

verification.provenance: Official institutional pages establish PHS stewardship, library services and LandCare delivery. Current 2026 programs, a dated June 2026 expansion announcement and the confirmed 2027 exhibition establish ongoing activity beyond URL reachability.
verification.research: The original 2018 JAMA Network Open paper, DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2018.0298, describes randomized comparisons of greening, cleanup and no intervention, with PHS implementing treatments. Methods, abstract, results and limitations inspected in HTML. Self-reported outcomes, attrition, study setting and nonsignificant overall poor-mental-health result limit broad claims. No reanalysis, new medical recommendation or assertion that findings transfer to other countries.
verification.archives: Official library description distinguishes catalog access, digitized collections, organizational finding aids, membership borrowing and historical research appointments. External collections were not independently browsed because retrieval was restricted.
verification.event: Public dates March 13-21, 2027 and member preview March 12 are reconciled against the official FAQ. Theme and showcase are announced plans. Older 2026 exhibitors navigation is not a confirmed 2027 lineup. No booking or availability claim.
verification.licensing: PHS website terms reserve rights and require permission for republication except where an item grants permission. The inspected JAMA article separately uses CC BY. This does not license PHS imagery, archives or other third-party components.
verification.live_site: Direct live Reservoir homepage and calendar retrieval failed. Existing page structures are retained; no independent browser display or search test claimed.

research_benchmark: Evaluate how a public flagship event relates to year-round delivery, maintenance, education, institutional records and separately designed outcome studies. Preserve administrative and program records alongside visual documentation; distinguish outputs, stewardship and measured effects rather than assuming event visibility demonstrates institutional continuity. This is a proposed analytical application, not a finding about another country or sector.
